question: Chosen Foods avocado oil manufacturer company
markdown:
Chosen Foods is a
San Diego-based company founded in 2010
that produces avocado oil, sprays, mayonnaise, and dressings. Acquired and backed by private equity firm Butterfly Equity, it is recognized as a leading brand of pure avocado oil utilizing a low-heat, naturally refined extraction process.
Global Food Industry News
Company Overview & Background
Founded:
2010 in San Diego, California, by Carsten Hagen.
Ownership:
Majority stake held by Los Angeles-based private equity firm Butterfly Equity.
Core Mission:
Replacing traditional seed oils and bad fats with 100% pure avocado oil.
Certifications:
Non-GMO Project Verified, kosher, gluten-free, and glyphosate residue-free.

Core Product Line
100% Pure Avocado Oil:
High smoke point up to 500°F (260°C) suited for high-heat sautéing, frying, and baking.

Propellant-free culinary cooking sprays.
Mayonnaise & Dressings:
Condiments made with avocado oil base.
